Task: Text Content Safety

Write Python code that flags or redacts unsafe spans from text using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

import os
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import requests


class OpenAIModerationRedactor:
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        model: str = "omni-moderation-latest",
        threshold: float = 0.5,
        timeout: int = 30,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
        self.model = model
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"

    def moderate(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        resp = requests.post(
            self.url,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            json={
                "model": self.model,
                "input": text,
            },
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()
        result = data["results"][0]

        categories = result.get("categories", {})
        category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
        flagged_categories = []

        for name, flagged in categories.items():
            score = category_scores.get(name, 0.0)
            if flagged or score >= self.threshold:
                flagged_categories.append(
                    {
                        "category": name,
                        "score": float(score),
                        "flagged": bool(flagged),
                    }
                )

        return {
            "flagged": bool(result.get("flagged", False) or flagged_categories),
            "flagged_categories": sorted(
                flagged_categories, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True
            ),
            "raw": result,
        }

    def redact(self, text: str, replacement: str = "[REDACTED]") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        moderation = self.moderate(text)
        if not moderation["flagged"]:
            return {
                "original_text": text,
                "redacted_text": text,
                "flagged": False,
                "redacted_spans": [],
                "flagged_categories": [],
            }

        redacted_spans = self._find_heuristic_spans(
            text, moderation["flagged_categories"]
        )
        redacted_text = self._apply_redactions(text, redacted_spans, replacement)

        return {
            "original_text": text,
            "redacted_text": redacted_text,
            "flagged": True,
            "redacted_spans": redacted_spans,
            "flagged_categories": moderation["flagged_categories"],
        }

    def _find_heuristic_spans(
        self, text: str, flagged_categories: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        patterns_by_category = {
            "violence": [
                r"\bkill(?:ed|ing|s)?\b",
                r"\bmurder(?:ed|ing)?\b",
                r"\bstab(?:bed|bing|s)?\b",
                r"\bshoot(?:ing|s|er|ers)?\b",
                r"\battack(?:ed|ing|s)?\b",
                r"\bbomb(?:ing|ed|s)?\b",
                r"\bweapon(?:s)?\b",
            ],
            "violence/graphic": [
                r"\bgore\b",
                r"\bblood(?:y)?\b",
                r"\bdismember(?:ed|ment)?\b",
                r"\bdecapitat(?:e|ed|ion)\b",
            ],
            "self-harm": [
                r"\bsuicid(?:e|al)\b",
                r"\bself[- ]harm\b",
                r"\bcut(?:ting)? myself\b",
                r"\boverdos(?:e|ed|ing)\b",
                r"\bend my life\b",
            ],
            "self-harm/instructions": [
                r"\bhow to (?:kill|hurt) myself\b",
                r"\bbest way to die\b",
                r"\bsuicide methods?\b",
            ],
            "harassment": [
                r"\bidiot\b",
                r"\bstupid\b",
                r"\bdumb\b",
                r"\bmoron\b",
                r"\bshut up\b",
                r"\bi hate you\b",
            ],
            "harassment/threatening": [
                r"\bi(?:'| a)?ll kill you\b",
                r"\byou(?:'| wi)?ll die\b",
                r"\bi(?:'| a)?ll hurt you\b",
                r"\bwatch your back\b",
            ],
            "hate": [
                r"\b(?:racial slur|ethnic slur)\b",
                r"\bgo back to your country\b",
            ],
            "hate/threatening": [
                r"\bexterminate\b",
                r"\blynch\b",
            ],
            "sexual": [
                r"\bsex\b",
                r"\bnude\b",
                r"\bporn\b",
                r"\bexplicit\b",
            ],
            "sexual/minors": [
                r"\bchild porn\b",
                r"\bunderage sex\b",
                r"\bminor(?:s)?\b",
            ],
            "illicit": [
                r"\bcocaine\b",
                r"\bheroin\b",
                r"\bmeth\b",
                r"\bfake id\b",
                r"\bbuy drugs\b",
            ],
            "illicit/violent": [
                r"\bbuild a bomb\b",
                r"\bmake explosives\b",
                r"\btraffic weapons\b",
            ],
        }

        spans: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen = set()

        for item in flagged_categories:
            category = item["category"]
            score = item["score"]
            patterns = patterns_by_category.get(category, [])
            for pattern in patterns:
                for match in re.finditer(pattern, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
                    key = (match.start(), match.end())
                    if key in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    spans.append(
                        {
                            "start": match.start(),
                            "end": match.end(),
                            "text": text[match.start() : match.end()],
                            "category": category,
                            "score": score,
                        }
                    )

        spans.sort(key=lambda s: (s["start"], s["end"]))
        return self._merge_spans(spans, text)

    def _merge_spans(
        self, spans: List[Dict[str, Any]], text: str
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not spans:
            return []

        merged = [spans[0].copy()]
        for span in spans[1:]:
            last = merged[-1]
            if span["start"] <= last["end"]:
                last["end"] = max(last["end"], span["end"])
                last["text"] = text[last["start"] : last["end"]]
                if span["score"] > last["score"]:
                    last["score"] = span["score"]
                    last["category"] = span["category"]
            else:
                merged.append(span.copy())
        return merged

    def _apply_redactions(
        self, text: str, spans: List[Dict[str, Any]], replacement: str
    ) -> str:
        if not spans:
            return text

        parts = []
        cursor = 0
        for span in spans:
            parts.append(text[cursor : span["start"]])
            parts.append(replacement)
            cursor = span["end"]
        parts.append(text[cursor:])
        return "".join(parts)
